name: How long does cabinet painting typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does cabinet painting typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a cabinet painting project varies based on the number of cabinets, their condition, and the chosen finish. Typically, a complete kitchen cabinet painting project can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days. This includes preparation steps like cleaning, sanding, priming, and applying multiple coats of paint, followed by adequate drying and curing time. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific kitchen size and cabinet layout during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet painting typically takes 3 to 7 days, depending on kitchen size and cabinet count. This includes preparation, painting, and drying.
